# ¿Que contiene este análisis?

Analizo la tendencia del valor de cuatro criptomonedas: Cardano (ADA), Ethereum (ETH), Bitcoin (BTC) y Polkadot (DOT). El valor se obtiene a través de [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/cryptocurrencies).

La media movil que acompaña la tendencia del precio de las critomonedas se calcula a 10 días y 30 días. También se incluye un cálculo de retorno a un mes de la fecha actual, estandarizado a **\$1** **US dolar**. Esto responde a: ¿Cuánto cambia el valor de un dolar que se invirtió hace un mes en criptomoneda?.

La última actualización se realizó el día: "`r Sys.Date()`". Por lo que la fecha a partir de la cuál se calcula el retorno es `r Sys.Date()-365`.

*Este análisis lo realizo de forma independiente. Si lo consideras útil puedes hacer una donación voluntaria en cualquiera de estas direciones. ```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=F}
library(quantmod)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(PerformanceAnalytics)
library(xts)
library(dygraphs)
library(htmltools)

#FORMATO, ORDEN Y RENOMBRE DE LOS DATOS
get_order = function(x, asset){
  x = data.frame(x)
  
  colnames(x) = c("open","high","low","close","volume","adjusted")
  
  x$date = rownames(x)
  
  x$date = ymd(x$date)
  
  x$asset  = asset
  
  x
}

#Obtiene retorno y utiliza get_order
get_metric = function(x, asset){
  r_d = dailyReturn(x)
  r_w = weeklyReturn(x)
  r_m = monthlyReturn(x)
  r_q = quarterlyReturn(x)
  
  r_d = data.frame(date = ymd(rownames(data.frame(r_d))), r_d = r_d[,1])
  r_w = data.frame(date = ymd(rownames(data.frame(r_w))), r_d = r_w[,1])
  r_m = data.frame(date = ymd(rownames(data.frame(r_m))), r_d = r_m[,1])
  r_q = data.frame(date = ymd(rownames(data.frame(r_q))), r_d = r_q[,1])
  
  returns = left_join(r_d, r_w) %>% left_join(r_m) %>% left_join(r_q)
  
  colnames(returns) = c("date", "r_d", "r_w", "r_m", "r_q")
  #
  x = get_order(x, asset)
  
  x = left_join(x, returns)
  
  x
}
get_ma = function(x){
  x$ma5 <- rollmean(x[,6], 5, fill = list(NA, NULL, NA), align = "right")
  x$ma10 <- rollmean(x[,6], 10, fill = list(NA, NULL, NA), align = "right")
  x$ma30 <- rollmean(x[,6], 30, fill = list(NA, NULL, NA), align = "right")
  x$ma50 <- rollmean(x[,6], 50, fill = list(NA, NULL, NA), align = "right")
  x
}

date_to_xts = function(x, col){
  x = xts(x = x[,col],
          order.by = as.Date(x[,1]),
          hayek_bday = as.POSIXct("1899-05-08"))
  x
}

return_dolar = function(x){
  
  x = lapply(x, function(y){
    y = Return.portfolio(y, wealth.index = TRUE)
    y = data.frame(date = ymd(rownames(data.frame(y))), r = y[,1])
    y
  })
  
  for (i in 1:length(x)) {
    x[[i]]$asset = names(x)[i]
  }
  
  bind_rows(x)
}

eth = getSymbols("ETH-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)
btc = getSymbols("BTC-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)
dot = getSymbols("DOT-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)
coti = getSymbols("COTI-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)
avax = getSymbols("AVAX-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)
atom = getSymbols("ATOM-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)
sol = getSymbols("SOL-USD", src = "yahoo", from = "2020-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE)

ada = get_metric(ada, "ada")
eth = get_metric(eth, "eth")
btc = get_metric(btc, "btc")
dot = get_metric(dot, "dot")
coti = get_metric(coti, "coti")
avax = get_metric(avax, "avax")
atom = get_metric(atom, "atom")
sol = get_metric(sol, "sol")


ada = get_ma(ada)
eth = get_ma(eth)
btc = get_ma(btc)
dot = get_ma(dot)
coti = get_ma(coti)
avax = get_ma(avax)
atom = get_ma(atom)
sol = get_ma(sol)

e_coins = bind_rows(ada, eth, btc, dot, coti, avax, atom, sol)
fecha_limite = ymd(Sys.Date()-30)
fecha_limite1 = ymd(Sys.Date()-90)
fecha_limite2 = ymd(Sys.Date()-180)
fecha_limite3 = ymd(Sys.Date()-365)

ada_qxts = filter(e_coins, asset == "ada")
ada_qxts <- xts(ada_qxts[,-7], order.by=ada_qxts[,7])

eth_qxts = filter(e_coins, asset == "eth")

btc_qxts = filter(e_coins, asset == "btc")

avax_qxts = filter(e_coins, asset == "avax")

atom_qxts = filter(e_coins, asset == "atom")

sol_qxts = filter(e_coins, asset == "sol")

dateWindow = c(Sys.Date()-15, Sys.Date())

  filter(!is.na(r_d)) %>% filter(date >= fecha_limite) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = r_d, names_from = asset) %>% data.frame()

return_dollar_d_list = list()

names(return_dollar_d_list) = c("ada", "eth", "btc", "dot","coti", "avax", "atom", "sol")

## ADA

```{r Figura1ADA, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap="Utiliza la barra para ver el registro histórico por día", message=FALSE, warning=F}
dygraph(ada_qxts[,c(1:4)], main = "Gráfica de vela", group = "CS") %>%
  dyCandlestick() %>%
  dyRangeSelector(dateWindow = dateWindow)
```

```{r Figura2ADA, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap="Tendencia del cierre ajustado y medias móviles (ma) calculados con umbrales temporales de distintos días. Utiliza la barra para ver el registro histórico por día", message=FALSE, warning=F}
dygraph(ada_qxts[,c(5,6,12,13,14,15)], main = "Tendencia diaria del valor ($US)",
        ylab = "Valor ajustado al cierre (US $)", group = "TC") %>%
  dyAxis("y2", label = "Volumen", independentTicks = TRUE) %>%
  dySeries("adjusted", color = "black") %>%
  dySeries("ma5", color = "green", strokeWidth = 1, strokePattern = "dashed")%>%
  dySeries("ma10", color = "#BBD500", strokeWidth = 1, strokePattern = "dashed") %>%
  dySeries("ma30", color = "orange", strokeWidth = 1, strokePattern = "dashed")%>%
  dySeries("ma50", color = "red", strokeWidth = 1, strokePattern = "dashed")%>%
  dySeries("volume", axis = 'y2', color = "gray", strokeWidth = 1, strokePattern = "dashed") %>%
  dyRangeSelector(dateWindow = dateWindow)
```
